description:
Create a precision technical drawing of a 96-well microplate (ANSI/SLAS 1-2004 standard) in LibreCAD. 

Goal: Save the drawing as '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/microplate_template.dxf'.

Specifications (Units: Millimeters):
1. LAYERS:
   - 'OUTLINE' (Color: White/7)
   - 'WELLS' (Color: Cyan/4)
   - 'LABELS' (Color: Yellow/2)

2. GEOMETRY:
   - On 'OUTLINE': Draw the plate footprint as a rectangle of width 127.76 mm and height 85.48 mm. Place the top-left corner at (0, 0) so it extends to X=127.76, Y=-85.48.
   - On 'WELLS': Draw 96 circular wells (Diameter 6.5 mm / Radius 3.25 mm).
     - Arrange in an 8-row x 12-column grid.
     - Center of Well A1 (top-left well) must be exactly at (14.38, -11.24).
     - Pitch (spacing) is 9.0 mm center-to-center in both X (columns) and Y (rows) directions.
   - On 'LABELS': Add text labels 'A1', 'A12', 'H1', 'H12' near their respective corner wells.
